original_test_intent: Verify controlled enablement of the receive-message queue on one identified BMC channel, including state query, transition, actual message reception and restoration, without changing other channels or broader BMC messaging controls.
original_method: The Master has no method. Standard Enable Message Channel Receive 0x06/0x32 is a candidate with an explicit channel selector and receive-state operation; the current state must be queried first and a real sender/receiver path must prove functional delivery after the approved change.
manual_activity: Engineer maps the BMC channel to its transport and consumer, authorizes enablement, supplies a bounded test sender/message and approves restoration of the previous receive state.
required_inputs: Verified BMC identity and protected OOB session
Platform channel map and selected channel number
Current receive state via query operation
Approved enable operation and reserved-bit encoding
Controlled peer message and recognizable payload
Prior-state restore and independent management recovery
safety_requirements: Do not assume channel zero or the active LAN session channel
Do not alter unrelated channels or Global Enables
Preserve message flags, queues and logs before change
Require explicit approval for the exact channel/state request
Use a bounded non-secret test payload from an approved peer
Verify response echoes/identifies the intended channel state
Do not drain production messages or auto-retry
agent_execution_scope: Resolve selected channel and queue consumer
Show the exact enable request and test-message plan for approval
Enable once and validate returned state
Send one approved identifiable message and verify its arrival without consuming unrelated content
Restore the original state if pre-approved and verify isolation
engineer_actions: Approve channel mapping, consumer and security exposure
Provide/approve the peer sender and payload
Define delivery acceptance and queue handling
Authorize restoration and own anomaly response

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: No command was supplied because the source is TBD. The standard command is identifiable, but a channel/state byte alone does not test the title unless message delivery is also demonstrated.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Query and then issue one protected `ipmitool ... raw 0x06 0x32 <channel> <approved-state>` using verified encodings, followed by one controlled message-delivery check and approved restoration.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Master TBD procedure/criteria and 10/5 metadata remain unchanged; channel, state, peer and timeout are not invented.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use a channel-aware harness that validates channel mapping, records query/enable/restore responses, injects one correlation-tagged message from the approved peer and isolates it from existing queue entries.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds an end-to-end receive oracle and channel-isolation evidence to an otherwise empty Master row.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: A successful state response without a delivered message proves configuration acceptance only, not that reception works; Get Message is supporting evidence, not a replacement case.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: The OOB transport used to send the command need not be the channel being enabled. Wrong mapping can change a management path, and a shared queue can contain unrelated operational messages.

project_override_considerations: A vendor UI may configure receive state only if it exposes the exact channel and readback; the project must still preserve the Master IPMI coverage delta and test actual bounded message receipt.
expected_evidence: BMC/channel/transport/consumer identity and current receive state
Raw query and exact approved enable request/response
Pre-change message flags, queue inventory and management health
Approved peer/payload hash or correlation tag and send timestamp
Target-message arrival within the defined window with unrelated messages preserved
Unchanged other channels, Global Enables, SEL and host/BMC health

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The Master is incomplete rather than contradictory. The title defines enablement, while the missing channel, sender and Expected are project bindings.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The standard operation and verification model are understandable. Execution waits for channel mapping, consumer, peer stimulus, approval and recovery; none are guessed.

review_improvement: Extends the V2 state-write contract with an end-to-end controlled receive proof, separates the command transport from the target channel and protects shared queues from destructive consumption.
independent_technical_reasoning: An enable bit is not sufficient evidence of channel reception. The configured channel can differ from the LAN path used to issue the command, and the queue may be shared with operational consumers. Correct testing therefore binds a channel map, one recognizable peer message and non-destructive queue correlation to the state transition, then proves that other channels and messages were unaffected.
